Advanced care for healthier gums*
Support your gum health every time you brush. Our Next-Generation Sonicare Technology offers a powerful yet gentle clean, even in hard-to-reach areas, with up to 100% healthier gums** and 1000% more plaque removal*.
See all benefits
Recommended sonic toothbrush brand by dental professionals worldwide

Advanced care for healthier gums*
1000% more plaque removal*
Up to 100% healthier gums**
Next-Generation Sonicare Technology
Pressure sensor
2 brush mode, 3 intensities
Up to 100% healthier gums**
Get a clean as unique as your smile. Our C3 Premium Plaque Control adapts to the contours of your teeth and gums thanks to soft, flexing sides for a comfortable, deep clean. The result is 1000% more plaque than a manual toothbrush* and up to 100% healthier gums in two weeks**.
Next-Generation Sonicare Technology
This electric toothbrush uses our Next-Generation Sonicare Technology which delivers our most reliable and consistent brushing for excellent results every time. The motor adjusts power automatically so there is zero drop in performance when you reach those harder-to-clean areas. Enjoy a gentle yet effective clean for your teeth and gums with 62,000 bristle movements per minute. Sonicare Fluid Action supports the bristles to clean by driving fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline.
Extra support to protect your gums
It’s easy to brush too hard, so this Philips Sonicare toothbrush has a smart optic sensor to detect excessive pressure. The sensor lets you know if you’re overdoing it through haptic vibrations. Ease off and your gums will stay protected!

Love it
I've been using the Philips Sonicare 6000 series electric toothbrush for a little while now, and, overall, I'm really happy with it. It cleans my teeth much better than a regular toothbrush, and it leaves my mouth feeling fresh every time. I like that it has different brushing modes, especially the clean and sensitive options. And the pressure sensor is a nice feature, too. It tells you if you're brushing too hard.
The battery life has been great and it's easy to charge. The only downside is that the replacement brush heads can be a little bit expensive, but the toothbrush itself performs really well. So, if you're looking for a quality electric toothbrush that does an excellent job cleaning your teeth, I definitely recommend it.

I now really look forward to going to the dentist for my checkup's because I know it's gonna be a breeze!!

features.name: Extra care for your gums
features.description: Get a clean as unique as your smile. Our C3 Premium Plaque Control adapts to the contours of your teeth and gums thanks to soft, flexing sides for a comfortable, deep clean. The result is 1000% more plaque than a manual toothbrush* and up to 100% healthier gums in two weeks**.

features.name: Next-Generation Sonicare Technology
features.description: This electric toothbrush uses our Next-Generation Sonicare Technology which delivers our most reliable and consistent brushing for excellent results every time. The motor adjusts power automatically so there is zero drop in performance when you reach those harder-to-clean areas. Enjoy a gentle yet effective clean for your teeth and gums with 62,000 bristle movements per minute. Sonicare Fluid Action supports the bristles to clean by driving fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline.

features.name: Pressure sensor
features.description: It’s easy to brush too hard, so this Philips Sonicare toothbrush has a smart optic sensor to detect excessive pressure. The sensor lets you know if you’re overdoing it through haptic vibrations. Ease off and your gums will stay protected!

features.name: Modes & Intensities
features.description: Give your clean a boost with 6 brushing settings. Whether you want a little more vigor or a specific focus for your clean, you can have it. Choose between Clean, Gum Health mode. Pick one of three intensity settings.

features.name: SmarTimer & BrushPacer
features.description: Ace your session time with Sonicare’s cleaning timers. Every 20 seconds, the BrushPacer will prompt you to clean a new area. After 2 minutes, the SmartTimer will indicate your session is complete.

features.name: Replacement reminder
features.description: Did you know brush heads become less effective after three months? Dental professionals recommend changing your brush head regularly, that's why Philips Sonicare toothbrushes have brush head replacement reminder. It tracks how often and how hard you brush, then reminds you to replace your brush head once it's time for a new one.

features.name: 21-day battery life
features.description: Experience up to 21 days of regular brushing after a single charge. Bringing a new level of convenience to your brushing routine.
